articles.summary: Equinor delivered an adjusted operating income* of USD 11.48 billion in the second quarter of 2026. Equinor reported a net operating income of USD 12.99 billion and a net income of USD 4.84 billion. Adjusted net income* was USD 3.22 billion, leading to adjusted earnings per share* of USD 1.33.
